text:
marie: heads up — customer in eu-west private deployment reported a sudden token-latency spike on /chat-route after yesterday's runtime bump. kernel selection flip to int8-quant seems to coincide.
aj: do we have per-token breakdowns for that tenant?
marie: yes, looked at the trace: token_parse ~1ms, kv_lookup ~0.5ms normally, but kv_cache misses jumped which increased kv_rehydrate by ~3-5ms per token for long histories. overall tail 95->350ms.
sanjeev: did the kernel-decider change thresholds? iirc we lowered sequence-length threshold for fused-attn to favor speed. could be causing more fallback to slower path for that model.
ellen: @marie can you paste the prometheus query you used? i want to add a dashboard panel for the customer slice.
marie: query I used: 
`sum by(route, tenant) (rate(token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]))`
then sliced with `route="/chat-route"` and tenant label. also used `kv_cache_miss_total{tenant="acme"}` — saw a 4x jump at 03:12 UTC.
aj: interesting — private deployment is air-gapped, right? how are we getting metrics? via the prometheus-proxy exporter they installed.
marie: yes, they use our airgap forwarder that writes a tarball and an S3-like pickup. they uploaded a metrics bundle.
ellen: can we reproduce locally with the same kernel selection policy? what kernel was picked in the trace logs?
marie: kernel="attn_fused_v2" selected initially, fallback to kernel="attn_ref_unfused" at step 32 for sequences >1024. the ref kernel has worse kv integration (sync path) which explains kv_rehydrate cost.
ops: infra-bot noticed a config drift: `kernel_thresholds.yaml` on that private box still had the old heuristic (seq_cutoff: 1024) while hosted got updated to 1536 in the rollout. marking as potential root cause. :warning:
aj: if private still at 1024, then requests with sequence around 1100 will choose the slower kernel. should we change the kernel-decider to be bundle-aware (prefer quantized kernel if kv_cache hit percent > 70)?
sanjeev: that makes sense. propose a cheap heuristic: route-level override in the kernel-decider: if route in high-kv routes AND kv_hit_rate>0.75 then prefer quantized_fused even if seq > cutoff. low-risk rollout.
ellen: dashboard changes: add a per-route panel for kv_hit_rate, kernel_selected, token_tail_latency. panel suggestions:
- kv_hit_rate = 1 - increase(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) / increase(token_requests_total[5m])
- kernel_selected as label series (use label_replace to expose kernel to Grafana)

marie: i can open a canary PR for the kernel-decider with the heuristic + unit tests. will also add a correlation alert: kv_hit_rate drop + kernel change -> notify eng-runtime and ops.
ops: for the air-gapped flow, we should also document how the prometheus relabeling can preserve tenant and route labels. current relabel config strips `route` on export which prevents per-route KPIs in customer Grafana.
aj: good catch. we should add an example snippet to docs for customers running the forwarder. something like:
```
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_runtime_route]
    target_label: route
  - source_labels: [__meta_runtime_tenant]
    target_label: tenant
```

ellen: i'll add panels to the private deployment Grafana template and a small playbook for customers: how to run the metrics-bundle upload, and how to validate kernel-selection labels.
sanjeev: one other action — add a lightweight profiler marker in runtime that emits `kernel_handoff_ms` per-request so we can see exact costs when fallback happens. small binary change but trivial to instrument.
marie: timeline: i'll ship the kernel-decider heuristic PR today (canary to hosted), add the `kernel_handoff_ms` metric in next patch, and update docs for the forwarder relabeling. ops, can you push the updated `kernel_thresholds.yaml` to the affected customer?
ops: noted. will coordinate with customer success and schedule a config push for 01:00 UTC. will also enable collection of the next bundle. :+1:
aj: thanks team. once the canary is up let's watch per-route 95/99 and kv_hit_rate for acme. set a temporary alert rule: if kv_hit_rate drops >20% and kernel changes to unfused, auto-roll back to previous policy.
marie: will add the alert and a quick runbook. happy to pair with anyone on the PR review.
infra-bot: deploy planned: kernel-decider-canary -> hosted dev cluster at 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z.
ellen: sweet. after canary, i'll backport dashboard panels to the on-prem Grafana templates and send the playbook to support.
marie: ok closing the thread — follow-ups: PR link, updated relabel snippet in docs, ops config push. will post updates here. :memo:
